"''What?|Pono talking to Jeen and their fellow technician|}} '''Jeen''' was a [[human]] [[technician]] that worked in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] during [[2 BBY]]. The day before the [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] delivered a speech denouncing the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Imperial Senate]] Jeen, along with a fellow technician [[Magla]],{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}} locked the door to a senate security closet and took its sequence key up to the required office. During the speech that commenced the following day, both individuals were called to the door by a security official named [[Pono]], who was under orders to shutdown the senate broadcast of the declaration. After informing him that they fixed the lock, as per protocol, and that he needed the sequence key, Pono rushed off to the office to retrieve the key. After Pono left, Jeen shared a smile with Magla. ==Personality and traits== Jeen had dark skin, [[color|brown]] eyes and black [[hair]]. While working at the Senate, they kept their hair in a bun and wore a blue [[jumpsuit]]. When Pono rushed to claim the sequence key to a senate security closet, Jeen exchanged a smile with their co-worker. ==Behind the scenes== Jeen appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They were portrayed by [[Amara Okereke]] in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Jeen}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ჯინი (ტექნიკოსი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Technicians]]
